purpose: Distinguish target-token learning failure, interference/overwrite, and continuation-loss improvement without semantic generalization after v14a5 passed the supervision-saturation precondition.
parent_lineage: canonical v14a2 with v14a5 supervision normalization/repair reused for authored behavior
tokenizer_contract: unchanged from v14a5: tokenizer_v9 with canonical special-token IDs

training_mechanics.lr_schedule: same warmup/cosine law as v14a5, evaluated on the original 100-update horizon
training_mechanics.objective: full chosen-answer continuation CE with prompt tokens masked

target_probe.families: all gradient_clipping semantic families from the pinned v14a4 family dataset
target_probe.selection: deterministic family-local shuffle from v14a5-normalized authored behavior
target_probe.exact_probe: chosen continuation CE and token top-1, aggregated and per family
target_probe.semantic_probe: existing v14a4 clean-family generator/evaluator restricted to gradient_clipping holdout rows

phase_1_target_pulse.data: only the fixed gradient_clipping target rows
phase_1_target_pulse.recycling: intentional within the fixed target subset; this phase is an overfit/plasticity diagnostic

phase_2_interference_chase.data: authored behavior from every non-gradient_clipping route/family
phase_2_interference_chase.family_schedule: round-robin over non-target route x family pools

decision_logic.target_token_learning_failure: Pulse-end exact NLL fails to improve by max(0.05, 1% of baseline NLL) and exact top-1 fails to improve by 0.02.
decision_logic.interference_or_overwrite: Target-token learning occurs during the pulse, then exact NLL/top-1 materially regress during the non-target chase, or semantic success acquired during the pulse regresses.
decision_logic.token_learning_without_semantic_generali: Exact target learning occurs during the pulse, does not meet interference criteria, but gradient_clipping clean-family macro success does not improve over baseline.
decision_logic.target_learning_and_semantic_transfer: Exact target learning occurs and gradient_clipping clean-family macro success improves without meeting interference criteria.
decision_logic.interpretation_strength: controlled diagnostic evidence, not causal proof
